faq.q: Will this pass our security review?
faq.a: Newron is designed for it: VPC, on-prem or air-gapped deployment, controls aligned to ISO 27001 with a SOC 2 Type II programme in progress, and a complete audit trail. We work directly with your security and procurement teams.

faq.q: Does it replace our core or LOS?
faq.a: No. Newron is API-first and integrates with your existing core, LOS and claims systems rather than replacing them.

faq.q: How long to first production use?
faq.a: Most banks reach a production pilot within a quarter, starting with one workflow and expanding from there.

faq.q: Can it follow our exact credit policy?
faq.a: Yes — Newron is configured to your policy book, tiers and formats, and evaluates deviations against your own rules with citations.

cta.title: Put Newron in front of your *risk team*.
cta.line: We'll run a sandboxed pilot inside your environment and give your security, risk and credit teams the evidence they need.
